newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips end higher, but off early levels.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips end higher, but off early levels.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks, supported by a strong dollar and gains in the bond market, finished higher Monday as the Wall Street chalked up its second consecutive winning session following last week's slide.

According to early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 29.84 points at 6,555.91 after earlier climbing to 6,589.14. In the broader market, advancing issues swamped declines by a 17-7 margin on heavy volume of 455 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.

The dollar climbed to a four-year high against the Japanese yen, and the benchmark 30-year Treasury bond gained more than half a point, pushing its yield down to 7.08 percent from 7.12 percent Friday. Stocks had staged a late rally Friday to gain 48 points but still lost 214 points for the week.
